item.tib: bcud dril bkra shis gter rdzong stag la dgongs 'dus zab mo 'dod pa dgos 'byung
item.coloph: 'chi med gsang ba'i rgyud las stag la mchog gi dgongs 'dus/ zab mo 'dod pa dgos 'byung zhes bya ba'o/ mkha' 'gro mas kho bo byang chub rdo rje rtsal gyi snyan du brgyud/ mu tsug smar ro// bya khri 'bar ba'i g.yas zur swa mA yA sA trig srug/
